name: Modbus TCP
description: Read and write Modbus TCP registers on PLCs, gateways and remote IO couplers. Devices are configured and connected right in the workbench, with polling and inline writes.
releaseNotes: 0.2.1: creating a connection asks only for a workspace name — devices are configured and connected inside the workbench, and a workbench opened with no connection still works. A new range reads ten addresses, editing its definition reads again on the spot, and values are written by double-clicking the cell of a holding register or coil.
